citations.quote: NDA 203971 is primarily supported by data from trial BC1-06 (ALSYMPCA); a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, international phase 3 trial enrolling patients with castration resistant prostate cancer and symptomatic bone metastases.

The BC1-06 trial randomized symptomatic castration resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) patients with at least 2 bone metastases and no sign of visceral metastatic disease in a 2:1 fashion to receive 6 monthly injections of Ra-223 + best standard of care (BSoc) or placebo + BSoc.
